issue_context.title: Add more warnings to inform the user that setting TiDB partition prune mode to dynamic at session level
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement

if we set tidb_partition_prune_mode='dynamic', it will show a warning "Please analyze all partition tables again for consistency between partition and global stats", this warning kinds of implying that "if you analyze all partition table again, everything will work fine"? 

But the fact is, if the partition mode is set at session level, even after analyzing all partition tables again, TiDB will meet some other problems, so maybe we should add more warnings to inform the user that setting TiDB partition prune mode to dynamic at session level is not recommended in production environment . 

If the user wants to use dynamic partition prune in a production environment, they should set partition prune mode to dynamic at global level .

review_comments: It is still not clear why one should use global level in the warning. Maybe a link to documentation to explain the reason?
Please add the test case for `set global tidb_partition_prune_mode`.
Please add a check `tk.MustQuery("show warnings")` here to verify that no warning is reported.
